evals.prompt: commit auto giúp tôi. Tôi vừa thêm validate password trong src/features/login/ (sửa index.tsx và thêm validate-password.ts + test), đang ở branch feat/login-validation.
evals.expected_output: Auto mode: one commit, no approval question, then a git log listing the hash and subject.
assertions: Skill states auto mode before inspecting
Runs git status and git diff HEAD --stat before committing
Stages explicit paths, not git add -A or git add .
Creates exactly one commit with a subject like feat(login): add password validation (lowercase, imperative, no period)
Does not ask for approval before committing
Commit message has no body and no Co-Authored-By trailer
Final report lists commit hash and subject and says nothing was pushed
Does not run git push

evals.prompt: commit manual: tôi có thay đổi trong src/features/todo/ (thêm filter completed), sửa typo trong README.md, và nâng version vite trong package.json. Đang ở branch chore/misc-updates.
evals.expected_output: Manual mode: plan with three separate commits (feat, docs, chore), each with its own files, then asks for approval and stops without committing.
assertions: Skill states manual mode
Splits the changes into at least three commits instead of one
Uses types feat, docs and chore for the respective commits
Plan lists the files and message of each commit
Asks the user to approve and stops before any git commit
No git commit has run before the user answers
No Co-Authored-By trailer in any planned message

evals.prompt: tạo commit cho tôi, tôi vừa sửa vài file trong src/shared/ và đang ở branch main.
evals.expected_output: Stops because the current branch is main; suggests creating a branch (create-branch skill) and makes no commit.
assertions: Detects the current branch is main
Refuses to commit and stops
Suggests creating a branch first, mentioning the create-branch skill if available
Runs no git add and no git commit
Defaults to manual mode when the user names none
